Finding the right pair of gym shorts comes down to what kind of training you do, how you like your liners, and your budget . According to testing and gear breakdowns from [That Fit Friend](https://thatfitfriend.com/best-mens-workout-shorts/) , here are the top-performing men's gym shorts broken down by category:[[1]](https://thatfitfriend.com/best-mens-workout-shorts/)

#### Top Picks by Category

1. **Best Overall & CrossFit:** [Ten Thousand Interval Short](https://www.google.com/search?ibp=oshop&prds=pvt:a,pvo:29,mid:576462543583745529,imageDocid:15215040304670415245,gpcid:9777553854296135122,headlineOfferDocid:13083950750635059073,catalogid:9514573720408243844,productDocid:7452636204613570274,rds:PC_9777553854296135122%7CPROD_PC_9777553854296135122&q=product&sa=X&ved=2ahUKEwjK56Pn64OYAxVjB9sEHQz2DHgQxa4PeggIAggBCCAQAg) ($64 – $68) — Durable, 4-way stretch, and available in 5", 7", and 9" inseams with or without a liner.[[1]](https://thatfitfriend.com/best-mens-workout-shorts/)

3. **Best for Big Thighs:** [Lululemon Pace Breaker Short](https://www.google.com/search?ibp=oshop&prds=pvt:a,pvo:29,mid:576462916523305652,imageDocid:6981000591864410509,gpcid:7101798860731157636,headlineOfferDocid:15136702462256674617,catalogid:11647802620628472157,productDocid:1785990293191488576,rds:PC_7101798860731157636%7CPROD_PC_7101798860731157636&q=product&sa=X&ved=2ahUKEwjK56Pn64OYAxVjB9sEHQz2DHgQxa4PeggIAggBCCAQDg) ($68) — Features a roomier shell that avoids pulling on muscular legs (5", 7", or 9" inseam).[[1]](https://thatfitfriend.com/best-mens-workout-shorts/)
4. **Best Liner:** [Vuori Kore Short](https://www.google.com/search?ibp=oshop&prds=pvt:a,pvo:29,mid:576462816864667430,imageDocid:6795804267051400599,gpcid:15351034071305839921,headlineOfferDocid:1860973380047937348,catalogid:8114675522019636015,productDocid:12560432193768657770,rds:PC_15351034071305839921%7CPROD_PC_15351034071305839921&q=product&sa=X&ved=2ahUKEwjK56Pn64OYAxVjB9sEHQz2DHgQxa4PeggIAggBCCAQFA) ($68) — Includes a comfortable, anti-odor boxer-brief liner in 5" or 7.5" inseams.[[1]](https://thatfitfriend.com/best-mens-workout-shorts/)
5. **Best for Running:** [WOLACO Warren Short](https://www.google.com/search?ibp=oshop&prds=pvt:a,pvo:29,mid:576462784503787850,imageDocid:17312744774088292421,gpcid:546655907268114521,headlineOfferDocid:2081440910748826880,catalogid:9698937182495975903,productDocid:5612740631503173907,rds:PC_7915961752520613202%7CPROD_PC_7915961752520613202&q=product&sa=X&ved=2ahUKEwjK56Pn64OYAxVjB9sEHQz2DHgQxa4PeggIAggBCCAQGg) ($78) — Offers sweatproof storage and anti-chafe design across 5", 7", and 10" inseams.[[1]](https://thatfitfriend.com/best-mens-workout-shorts/)
6. **Best for Lounging:** [Vuori Sunday Performance Short](https://www.google.com/search?ibp=oshop&prds=pvt:a,pvo:29,mid:576462459996567546,imageDocid:1012144017629283385,gpcid:9003331648843702163,headlineOfferDocid:9227730564212526531,catalogid:3647750075237317016,productDocid:14264269711704923755,rds:PC_9003331648843702163%7CPROD_PC_9003331648843702163&q=product&sa=X&ved=2ahUKEwjK56Pn64OYAxVjB9sEHQz2DHgQxa4PeggIAggBCCAQIA) ($78 – $84) — Ultra-soft, relaxed, and unlined in 7" or 9" inseams.[[1]](https://thatfitfriend.com/best-mens-workout-shorts/)
7. **Best Budget Pick:** [CRZ Yoga 2-In-1 Short](https://www.google.com/search?ibp=oshop&prds=pvt:a,pvo:29,mid:576462771505050558,imageDocid:16410622018473831091,gpcid:6090402738737996916,headlineOfferDocid:5744927402945240318,catalogid:7054167891569252518,productDocid:13210738714601185873,rds:PC_7311586218078839524%7CPROD_PC_7311586218078839524&q=product&sa=X&ved=2ahUKEwjK56Pn64OYAxVjB9sEHQz2DHgQxa4PeggIAggBCCAQJg) ($32) — Delivers compression-liner performance and mobility at a lower price point.[[1]](https://thatfitfriend.com/best-mens-workout-shorts/)

To narrow this down, let me know:

- What **type of workouts** do you mostly do (lifting, running, CrossFit, or general fitness)?
- Do you prefer **lined or unlined** shorts?
- What **inseam length** (5", 7", or longer) do you usually go for?
